trap-thesis-restatement.notes: SEPARATE (non-trap) MATH finding - the worked example's numbers are the CLASSICAL q = 1 values, not the substrate-q_0 values it says they are. The block states 'Direct computation of the Hoefsmit characters on the three partitions lambda |- 3 AT THE SUBSTRATE q_0 gives' and tabulates chi_(3) = +1, chi_(2,1) = -1, chi_(1^3) = +1, then a_{4_1} = w_(3).1 + w_(2,1).(1/4) + w_(1^3).1. Recomputed from the block's OWN braid word beta_{4_1} = sigma_1 sigma_2^-1 sigma_1 sigma_2^-1 in the 2-dimensional [2,1] rep of H_3: chi_(2,1)(beta) = q^4 - 2q^2 + 1 - 2q^-2 + q^-4, which at q_0 = 1.1099785827513808 equals -0.910677350271, NOT -1. The normalisation is chi_(2,1)(1) = [2]_q = q_0 + 1/q_0 = 2.01089686671, not 2, so chi^2/chi(1)^2 = 0.205092356746, NOT 1/4 - the quoted 1/4 is 21.90% HIGH. The values -1 and 1/4 are exactly what the formulas give at q = 1 (S_3 standard character at a 3-cycle = -1, classical dim = 2). chi_(3) and chi_(1^3) are +1 at every q, so (2,1) is the only q-dependent entry and it is the one that is wrong. FIX: either relabel the table 'classical limit q = 1' or replace the entries with the q_0 values / the exact Laurent polynomial. THIRD VALUE IN THE SAME CHAPTER: tbl:figure-eight-branching-rule-table1-data gives chi(4_1, [2,1]) = -1 - h^2 = -1.0437 at q_0. So this one quantity appears as -1 (here), -1.0437 (branching table) and -0.9107 (true) - and only THIS block uses the correct braid word for 4_1. SWEEP DAMAGE: the closing sentence 'See the computational verification in the canonical formalism.' has the script name replaced; the .ts names computations/probes/knot_factor_amphicheiral_BD_probe.py.
